title: How the paper clip took over

beats.line: Almost every desk in the world has a paper clip somewhere on it.
title: Every desk
beats.metaphor: hundreds of clips swirl in and pour into a pencil cup on a desk
beats.camera: static on the desk, slight push in

beats.line: But back in 1899, it was just one of dozens of strange wire designs.
beats.metaphor: year dial spins back to 1899; odd wire designs orbit one clip
beats.camera: tilt up from the desk to the dial

beats.line: Then one simple shape launched ahead of all the others.
title: One simple shape
beats.metaphor: the clip ignites and flies up like a rocket, leaving the others behind; burst
beats.camera: follow the rocket up into the sky
